column3: The attachment block escapes names, types and paths, escapes only file/attachments tags inside inlined content, and sends an image part only when the bytes match the type's signature
column4: Review of #67: a crafted name or file body could close the wrapper and forge prompt markup; escaping all of an inlined file would garble code the model reads, so only the wrapper's own tags are escaped. HTML uploaded as image/png must not reach a provider as an image
column5: attachments.test.ts 'escapes hostile names and keeps an inlined file inside its wrapper' and 'never sends HTML stored as image/png as an image'
